title: ‘Creative environmental engineering’ and the cost of environmental claims: legitimisation of tire artificial reefs by US federal scientists in 1960s–1970s
core_idea: Investigates the Sandy Hook Marine Laboratory artificial reef study and analyzes the environmental claims constructed around proposals to use waste materials, especially tires, in reef construction by US federal fisheries scientists.
tldr: Analyzes the Sandy Hook study (1966–1974) to examine how environmental claims about using waste materials, notably tires, for artificial reefs were produced and articulated by US federal fisheries scientists.
